text: ひとがいて　さきに　すすめない！

structure.jp: さきに　すすめない！

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this part to the next, and here it also gives the reason. ひとが いて = 'someone is there, so...'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: The 'can do' form: for verbs like すすむ the last sound changes to an え-sound (すすめる). すすめない = 'can't go forward'.
